text.en: Atlas design study for this topic (docs/36-states-of-matter-content-spec.md §2–§4 and §9): a generic school science bench drawn life size, not a specific product. DESIGN: bench 1.80 × 0.70 m, side table 0.80 × 0.60 m; measuring cylinders 250 ml, inner radius 1.85 cm, a line drawn every 10 ml; tall glass inner radius 3.0 cm, 12 cm deep; conical flask inside 4.2 cm radius at the bottom narrowing to 1.6 cm 10 cm up, then a 4 cm neck; bowl a half ball of inner radius 8 cm; stone 25 cm³ at 2.65 g/cm³; sponge 12 × 8 × 4 cm (384 cm³) at 0.030 g/cm³; glass marble 16 mm across (2.1 cm³) at 2.5 g/cm³; modelling clay 20 cm³ at 1.60 g/cm³, as a ball of radius 1.68 cm or a roll 1.6 cm thick and 10.5 cm long; water 0.997 g/ml; basin inner radius 12 cm, water 14.0 cm deep; upside-down cup inner radius 3.5 cm, 9.0 cm deep, glass 57.9 cm³, rim 3.0 cm above the basin floor when pushed down; basketball 75 cm round, 600.0 g unpumped, 7.0 litres inside, 0.2 litres of room air per stroke; air 1.18 g per litre; atmosphere 101.325 kPa; g = 9.8 N per kg; three 20 ml syringes of 2.0 cm bore, tips sealed, 1 kg masses; dry sand with 35 % air space; slope of a sand heap 33°. SIM: balance readings stone 66.3 g, sponge 11.5 g, marble 5.4 g, clay 32.0 g, 200 ml water 199.4 g. Cylinder with 100 ml: nothing 100 ml, stone 125 ml, marble 102 ml, clay ball 120 ml, clay roll 120 ml. 200 ml of water stands 18.6 cm in the cylinder, 7.1 cm in the glass, 5.0 cm in the flask, 3.0 cm deep in the bowl, and measures 200 ml when poured back. Basketball after 0, 5, 10, 15, 20 pumps: 600.0, 601.2, 602.4, 603.5, 604.7 g (air pumped in 0, 1.2, 2.4, 3.5, 4.7 g; 0.236 g a stroke). Cup: basin 14.0 cm with the cup above; pushed down with its air trapped, basin 14.9 cm (8.9 mm higher), water inside 1.0 mm above the rim, tissue dry; with a hole, basin 14.1 cm (1.3 mm higher), cup full, tissue wet. Syringes with 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 kg on each plunger: air 20.0, 15.3, 12.4, 10.4, 9.0 ml; water 20.0 ml (0.001 ml less at 4 kg); sand 20.0 ml. 100 ml of dry sand with 0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100 ml of water poured in: 100, 100, 105, 125, 145, 165 ml; air left 35, 15, 0, 0, 0, 0 ml.
text.zh: 本主题的 Atlas 设计研究（docs/36-states-of-matter-content-spec.md §2–§4、§9）：按实物大小画的通用学校科学实验台，不代表任何具体产品。设计值：实验台 1.80 × 0.70 米，小桌 0.80 × 0.60 米；量筒 250 毫升，内半径 1.85 厘米，每 10 毫升画一条线；高玻璃杯内半径 3.0 厘米、深 12 厘米；锥形瓶内部底半径 4.2 厘米，往上 10 厘米收到 1.6 厘米，再接 4 厘米瓶颈；碗是内半径 8 厘米的半球；石头 25 立方厘米，每立方厘米 2.65 克；海绵 12 × 8 × 4 厘米（384 立方厘米），每立方厘米 0.030 克；玻璃弹珠直径 16 毫米（2.1 立方厘米），每立方厘米 2.5 克；模型黏土 20 立方厘米，每立方厘米 1.60 克，搓成半径 1.68 厘米的球，或粗 1.6 厘米、长 10.5 厘米的长条；水每毫升 0.997 克；水盆内半径 12 厘米，水深 14.0 厘米；倒扣的杯子内半径 3.5 厘米、深 9.0 厘米，玻璃 57.9 立方厘米，压下去时杯口离盆底 3.0 厘米；篮球周长 75 厘米，未打气 600.0 克，里面 7.0 升，每打一下压进 0.2 升室内空气；空气每升 1.18 克；大气压 101.325 千帕；g = 每千克 9.8 牛；三支 20 毫升针筒，内径 2.0 厘米，针口封住，砝码每块 1 千克；干沙里 35 % 是空气；沙堆坡度 33°。模拟值：秤的读数：石头 66.3 克，海绵 11.5 克，弹珠 5.4 克，黏土 32.0 克，200 毫升水 199.4 克。装 100 毫升水的量筒：不放东西 100 毫升，石头 125 毫升，弹珠 102 毫升，黏土球 120 毫升，黏土长条 120 毫升。200 毫升水在量筒里高 18.6 厘米，在杯里 7.1 厘米，在锥形瓶里 5.0 厘米，在碗里深 3.0 厘米，倒回量筒都是 200 毫升。篮球打 0、5、10、15、20 下：600.0、601.2、602.4、603.5、604.7 克（打进的空气 0、1.2、2.4、3.5、4.7 克，每下 0.236 克）。杯子：杯在上方时盆里水深 14.0 厘米；压下去、空气关在里面，盆里 14.9 厘米（升高 8.9 毫米），杯里的水比杯口高 1.0 毫米，纸巾干；杯底开孔，盆里 14.1 厘米（升高 1.3 毫米），杯里灌满水，纸巾湿。每支柱塞上放 0、1、2、3、4 千克：空气 20.0、15.3、12.4、10.4、9.0 毫升；水 20.0 毫升（4 千克时少 0.001 毫升）；沙 20.0 毫升。100 毫升干沙里倒 0、20、40、60、80、100 毫升水：读数 100、100、105、125、145、165 毫升；剩下的空气 35、15、0、0、0、0 毫升。

note.en: Not a measurement: the model gives the same readings every time, and a real experiment differs a little each time (reading the scale, the balance drifting, how tightly the sand packs, whether the cup goes straight down). Masses = volume × density, rounded to the balance's 0.1 g. A solid's volume = the cylinder reading − 100 ml (1 ml = 1 cm³, S11). Water heights come from the inside outline of each vessel, the same outline the stage fills. Ball: air in = pumps × 0.2 litres × 1.18 g per litre; the ball keeps its outside size, so the push of the air around it does not change and the extra reading is the air alone; pressure inside, which the text does not use, rises by pumps × 0.2 ÷ 7.0 × 101.3 kPa, 57.9 kPa after 20 pumps, inside the NBA's 7.5–8.5 psi (51.7–58.6 kPa, S10). Cup: the trapped air obeys Boyle's law (S5) at the depth of the water, solved with the water's volume kept the same. Syringes: extra pressure = mass × 9.8 ÷ 3.14 cm²; air volume = 20 × 101.3 ÷ (101.3 + extra pressure in kPa) (S5); water volume = 20 × (1 − 4.5 × 10⁻⁷ × extra pressure) (S7); the sand grains are taken to touch and hold the plunger still, a simplification (real loose sand can settle a little). Sand: reading = 100 + the water beyond the 35 ml of air space (S12). The sizes of the vessels, the 7.0 litre inside of the ball, the 0.2 litre stroke (real pumps differ, S43) and the 35 % air space are design choices inside the sourced ranges where a range exists (S12, S15–S21, S38, S40–S42); they are not taken from a standard or a product.
note.zh: 不是实测值：模型每次给出同样的读数，真实实验每次都会差一点（读刻度、秤的漂移、沙压得多紧、杯子是否竖直压下）。质量 = 体积 × 密度，按秤的 0.1 克取整。固体的体积 = 量筒读数 − 100 毫升（1 毫升 = 1 立方厘米，S11）。水的高度由各个容器的内部轮廓算出，舞台上画水用的也是这个轮廓。篮球：打进的空气 = 打气次数 × 0.2 升 × 每升 1.18 克；球的外面大小不变，周围空气托它的力不变，所以多出来的读数只是空气；球里的气压（正文不用）每下升高 0.2 ÷ 7.0 × 101.3 千帕，20 下后 57.9 千帕，在 NBA 的 7.5–8.5 磅（51.7–58.6 千帕，S10）之内。杯子：关在里面的空气在水深处按玻意耳定律（S5）压缩，与水量守恒联立求解。针筒：增加的压强 = 质量 × 9.8 ÷ 3.14 平方厘米；空气体积 = 20 × 101.3 ÷（101.3 + 增加的压强，千帕）（S5）；水的体积 = 20 ×（1 − 4.5 × 10⁻⁷ × 增加的压强）（S7）；沙粒按互相顶住、柱塞不动处理，这是简化（真实的松沙会沉下去一点）。沙：读数 = 100 + 超过 35 毫升空隙的那部分水（S12）。容器尺寸、篮球里的 7.0 升、每下 0.2 升（真实的打气筒各不相同，S43）和 35 % 的空隙是设计取值，有来源范围的都落在范围内（S12、S15–S21、S38、S40–S42）；它们不是从标准或产品抄来的。

text.en: Ministry of Education, Singapore (CPDD), Science Teaching & Learning Syllabus, Primary Three to Six, Standard / Foundation (implementation from the 2023 Primary Three cohort; cover updated January 2026). Page 48, Cycles in Matter and Water (Matter): state that matter is anything that has mass and occupies space; differentiate among the three states of matter (solid, liquid, gas) in terms of shape and volume; measure mass and volume using appropriate apparatus. Pages 49–50: water can exist in three states. Page 76: state that heat is a form of energy.
text.zh: 新加坡教育部课程规划与发展司，《小学三至六年级科学教学大纲（标准 / 基础）》（2023 年小三学生起实施，封面 2026 年 1 月更新）。第 48 页“物质与水的循环（物质）”：说出物质是任何有质量、占据空间的东西；从形状和体积区分物质的三态（固体、液体、气体）；用合适的器材测量质量和体积。第 49–50 页：水能以三种状态存在。第 76 页：说出热是一种能量。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (page numbers are those printed at the foot). Page 48 has no Note line. A search of the whole document finds no mention of particles, compression or displacement: these are not named in the primary syllabus, which is different from being excluded. The only topic the document says is not required is density (page 39, Primary 3).
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（页码是页脚印的数字）。第 48 页没有注释行。全文检索找不到“微粒”“压缩”“排水法”：小学课纲没有讲到它们，这和“明确不要求”不同。文件里明说不要求的只有密度（第 39 页，小三）。

text.en: A. Thompson and B. N. Taylor, Guide for the Use of the International System of Units (SI), NIST Special Publication 811 (2008), §B.3 and Appendix B: 1 standard atmosphere = 101 325 Pa exactly.
text.zh: A. Thompson、B. N. Taylor，《国际单位制使用指南》，美国国家标准与技术研究院特别出版物 811（2008），§B.3 与附录 B：1 标准大气压 = 101 325 帕（精确值）。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (printed pages 40 and 45). The model takes the air in the room at 101.325 kPa.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（印刷页第 40、45 页）。模型把室内的气压取为 101.325 千帕。

text.en: NASA Glenn Research Center, Beginner's Guide to Aeronautics, Boyle's Law: for a fixed amount of gas kept at the same temperature, the product of pressure and volume stays nearly constant, so squeezing a gas into half the space doubles its pressure.
text.zh: 美国国家航空航天局格伦研究中心，《航空入门》“玻意耳定律”：一定量的气体保持温度不变时，压强和体积的乘积几乎不变；把气体压进一半的空间，压强就加倍。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. Used for the air in the sealed syringe and in the upside-down cup, loaded slowly so that the temperature stays the same. The law and its formula are not taught in the chapters; the primary syllabus doesn't cover compression, and it is studied in secondary school.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。用于封口针筒里和倒扣杯子里的空气，慢慢加压、温度不变。各章正文不教这条定律和它的式子；小学课纲没有讲压缩，中学会学。

text.en: A. Picard, R. S. Davis, M. Gläser and K. Fujii, Revised formula for the density of moist air (CIPM-2007), Metrologia 45 (2008) 149–155. Worked from its equations at standard pressure: dry air at 20 °C, 1.205 kg per cubic metre; at 25 °C, 1.184; at 25 °C and 50 % humidity, 1.177.
text.zh: A. Picard、R. S. Davis、M. Gläser、K. Fujii，《湿空气密度的修订公式（CIPM-2007）》，《Metrologia》45 (2008) 149–155。按其公式在标准气压下计算：20 °C 干空气每立方米 1.205 千克；25 °C 为 1.184；25 °C、湿度 50 % 为 1.177。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (printed pages 150–154). The densities above are calculated from the published equations, not copied from a table. Air density depends on temperature, pressure and humidity; the model rounds it to 1.18 g per litre (25 °C, standard pressure). With the unrounded 1.184, the reading after 15 pumps would be 603.6 g instead of 603.5 g; all other readings are unchanged.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（印刷页第 150–154 页）。上面的密度是用文中公式算出的，不是从表里抄的。空气密度随温度、气压、湿度而变；模型取整为每升 1.18 克（25 °C、标准气压）。如果用不取整的 1.184，打 15 下后的读数是 603.6 克而不是 603.5 克，其余读数不变。

text.en: International Association for the Properties of Water and Steam, Revised Supplementary Release on Properties of Liquid Water at 0.1 MPa, SR6-08 (2011), Table 8 at 25 °C: density 997.047 kg per cubic metre; from its Tables 3 and 8, the isothermal compressibility is 4.52 × 10⁻¹⁰ per pascal.
text.zh: 国际水和蒸汽性质协会，《0.1 兆帕下液态水性质的修订补充公报》SR6-08（2011），表 8，25 °C：密度每立方米 997.047 千克；由表 3、表 8 得等温压缩率每帕 4.52 × 10⁻¹⁰。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (page 11, Table 8; page 6, Table 3). The model uses 0.997 g per millilitre and 4.5 × 10⁻⁷ per kPa. The US Geological Survey's Water Density page agrees but has no 25 °C row.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（第 11 页表 8、第 6 页表 3）。模型用每毫升 0.997 克和每千帕 4.5 × 10⁻⁷。美国地质调查局的“水的密度”网页与此一致，但没有 25 °C 一行。

text.en: National Basketball Association, Official Rules, Rule No. 1, Section II, Equipment: the ball shall be an officially approved NBA ball between 7½ and 8½ pounds pressure.
text.zh: 美国职业篮球联赛（NBA）官方规则第 1 条第 II 节“器材”：比赛用球须是官方认可的球，气压在 7½ 到 8½ 磅之间。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. Pounds pressure is read as pounds per square inch, about 51.7 to 58.6 kPa above the air outside. This is one league's rule, used only as a reference for when the model ball is firm; it is not a safe limit for every ball. The rule gives no size or mass; FIBA's figures are S38.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。“磅”按每平方英寸磅读，约比外面的空气高 51.7 到 58.6 千帕。这是一个联赛的规则，只用来判断模型里的球什么时候“鼓起来了”；它不是所有球的安全上限。规则里没有大小和质量；国际篮联的数字见 S38。

text.en: American Chemical Society, Middle School Chemistry, Chapter 3 Lesson 2, Finding Volume: The Water Displacement Method: read the line at the bottom of the curved water surface; the volume of an object is the final water level minus the initial water level; 1 mL = 1 cm³.
text.zh: 美国化学会《初中化学》第 3 章第 2 课“求体积：排水法”：读弯曲水面最低处对着的刻度线；物体的体积 = 放入后的水面读数 − 放入前的读数；1 毫升 = 1 立方厘米。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (lesson pages 3–4). The object must be completely under the water and must not float, dissolve, soak up water or carry bubbles. The lesson goes on to density, which this topic does not use.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（课文第 3–4 页）。物体要整个没入水中，不能浮、不能溶、不能吸水，也不能带着气泡。这一课接着讲密度，本主题不用。

text.en: R. A. Freeze and J. A. Cherry, Groundwater (Prentice-Hall, 1979), Table 2.4, Range of values of porosity: sand 25–50 %.
text.zh: R. A. Freeze、J. A. Cherry，《地下水》（Prentice-Hall，1979），表 2.4“孔隙率的取值范围”：沙 25 %–50 %。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 in the complete edition preserved by The Groundwater Project (printed page 37). The table is a textbook summary of other measurements. A packing study in Soil Science Society of America Journal 60 (1996) 49–53 measured porosities of 0.325 for carefully packed dry sand and 0.315 for wet sand packed under vibration, so the air space depends on how the sand is packed. The model's 35 % is a design value inside the range.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 在“地下水项目”保存的完整版本中读取（印刷页第 37 页）。这张表是教科书对其他测量的汇总。《美国土壤科学学会杂志》60 (1996) 49–53 的一项装填研究测得：仔细装填的干沙孔隙率 0.325，振动装填的湿沙 0.315，可见空隙多少和沙怎么装有关。模型取 35 %，是范围内的设计值。

text.en: US Geological Survey, USGS Thesaurus, Sand deposits: deposits of loose particles of rock or mineral that range in size from 0.0625 to 2.0 millimetres in diameter.
text.zh: 美国地质调查局《USGS 主题词表》“沙沉积”：由松散的岩石或矿物颗粒组成的沉积，颗粒直径 0.0625 到 2.0 毫米。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. A size class, not a measurement of any particular sand. The magnified grains are drawn 0.2–1.0 mm across, inside this class.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。这是粒径分级，不是某一种沙的测量值。放大图里的沙粒按 0.2–1.0 毫米画，在这个范围之内。

text.en: N. Murdoch and others, An experimental study of low-velocity impacts into granular material in reduced gravity, Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society (2017), §3.2: the angle of repose of the quartz sand used was 32.5° ± 2.4°.
text.zh: N. Murdoch 等，《低重力下低速撞击颗粒物质的实验研究》，《英国皇家天文学会月刊》（2017），§3.2：所用石英沙的休止角为 32.5° ± 2.4°。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (authors' preprint, page 4). Oven-dried golf-bunker sands measured by Bigelow and Smith (USGA Turfgrass and Environmental Research Online 7(3), 2008, Table 2) settle at about 30 to 35°. The slope depends on the sand and on how it is poured; the model's 33° is a design value.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（作者预印本第 4 页）。Bigelow 与 Smith 测量烘干的高尔夫沙坑用沙（《USGA 草坪与环境研究在线》7(3)，2008，表 2），休止角约 30° 到 35°。坡度取决于沙的种类和倒法；模型的 33° 是设计值。

text.en: Study on the mechanical properties of granite responses of cyclic heating and water cooling, PLOS ONE, article e0312460: the average density of the granite specimens without heat treatment was 2.65 g/cm³.
text.zh: 《循环加热与水冷下花岗岩力学性质的研究》，《PLOS ONE》论文 e0312460：未经热处理的花岗岩试样平均密度为每立方厘米 2.65 克。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (Preparation of granite specimens). One measured granite, used as a reference value for the model stone; other rocks and other stones differ.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（花岗岩试样制备一节）。这是一种花岗岩的实测值，用作模型石头的参考；别的岩石、别的石头会不同。

text.en: Pilkington North America (NSG Group), Properties of Soda-Lime-Silica Float Glass, technical bulletin ATS-129: density 2500 kg per cubic metre.
text.zh: 皮尔金顿北美公司（NSG 集团），《钠钙硅浮法玻璃的性质》技术公报 ATS-129：密度每立方米 2500 千克。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (page 1). A reference value for ordinary glass, used for the model marble; it is not a measurement of a toy marble.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（第 1 页）。这是普通玻璃的参考值，用于模型里的弹珠，不是玩具弹珠的实测值。

text.en: Covestro, Flexible slabstock foam: most flexible foam blocks have a density between 15 and 60 kg per cubic metre.
text.zh: 科思创，《软质块状泡沫》：大多数软泡沫块的密度在每立方米 15 到 60 千克之间。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. Flexible polyurethane foam, the usual material of household sponges; the model's 30 kg per cubic metre is inside the range.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。软质聚氨酯泡沫是家用海绵常见的材料；模型取每立方米 30 千克，在范围之内。

text.en: Chavant, catalogue, Guide to Chavant Clay Density, page 3: DaVinci Soft, specific gravity 1.60 g/cm³.
text.zh: Chavant 公司产品目录，“黏土密度指南”，第 3 页：DaVinci Soft，比重每立方厘米 1.60 克。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. Other clays in the same table range from 1.05 to 1.65 g/cm³; lightweight clays are much lighter. One product is named here only as the source of the value; the model clay is not a particular product.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。同一张表里别的黏土从每立方厘米 1.05 到 1.65 克；轻黏土要轻得多。这里列出一种产品只是说明数值的来源；模型里的黏土不代表任何产品。

text.en: International Organization for Standardization, ISO 4788:2005, Laboratory glassware — Graduated measuring cylinders; and a 250 mL Class A cylinder built to it (DWK Life Sciences, catalogue 213903604): diameter 39 mm, height 331 mm, capacity 250 mL, graduation intervals 2 mL.
text.zh: 国际标准化组织 ISO 4788:2005《实验室玻璃器皿　带刻度的量筒》；以及一只按此标准制造的 250 毫升 A 级量筒（DWK 生命科学，目录号 213903604）：直径 39 毫米，高 331 毫米，容量 250 毫升，分度 2 毫升。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20: the standard's official abstract (its dimension tables were not available) and the maker's product page. The 39 mm is the outside; the model's inner radius of 1.85 cm is a design choice, and the model draws a line every 10 ml rather than every 2 ml.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取：标准的官方摘要（尺寸表无法读到）和厂商的产品页。39 毫米是外径；模型的内半径 1.85 厘米是设计取值，模型每 10 毫升画一条线，而不是每 2 毫升。

text.en: International Organization for Standardization, ISO 1773:1997, Laboratory glassware — Narrow-necked boiling flasks; and a 250 mL narrow-neck conical flask built to it (DWK Life Sciences): outer diameter 85 mm, neck 34 mm, height 145 mm.
text.zh: 国际标准化组织 ISO 1773:1997《实验室玻璃器皿　窄口烧瓶》；以及一只按此标准制造的 250 毫升窄口锥形瓶（DWK 生命科学）：外径 85 毫米，瓶颈 34 毫米，高 145 毫米。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20: the standard's catalogue entry and the maker's specification table. Neither gives the inside outline; the model's flask outline is a design choice of similar size.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取：标准的目录条目和厂商的规格表。两者都没有给出内部轮廓；模型的锥形瓶轮廓是大小相近的设计取值。

text.en: World Precision Instruments, AL-8000 syringe pump manual, syringe table: inside diameters of 20 mL syringes from four makers, 19.05 to 20.15 mm; and Becton, Dickinson and Company, 20 mL syringe 301031: major graduations every 5 mL, minor every 1 mL.
text.zh: World Precision Instruments，AL-8000 注射泵说明书的针筒表：四家厂商的 20 毫升针筒内径 19.05 到 20.15 毫米；以及 BD 公司 20 毫升针筒 301031：每 5 毫升一条大刻度，每 1 毫升一条小刻度。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (manual page 3; BD product page). The model syringe's 2.0 cm bore is a design value inside this spread; its readings to 0.1 ml are the model's, while a real syringe can be read to about half a 1 ml mark.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（说明书第 3 页；BD 产品页）。模型针筒内径 2.0 厘米，是这个范围内的设计值；读数写到 0.1 毫升是模型的精度，真实针筒只能估到 1 毫升一格的一半左右。

text.en: OpenStax, Chemistry 2e, §1.2 Phases and Classification of Matter: a solid is rigid and possesses a definite shape; a liquid flows and takes the shape of its container; a gas takes both the shape and volume of its container; sand is made of grains of solid sand.
text.zh: OpenStax《化学》第 2 版 §1.2“物质的相与分类”：固体是刚性的，有固定的形状；液体会流动，形状随容器而定；气体的形状和体积都随容器而定；沙由一粒粒固体沙粒组成。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. Its figure labels solids and liquids as having a fixed volume. The same section explains states with particles, which this topic keeps to one box beyond the syllabus.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。书中的图把固体和液体标为体积固定。同一节用微粒解释物质的状态，本主题只在一块“课纲之外”的细看里提到。

text.en: National Institute of Standards and Technology, Office of Weights and Measures, SI Units — Mass: mass is a measure of how much matter an object contains; the SI unit of mass is the kilogram (kg); weight is the force of gravity on the object.
text.zh: 美国国家标准与技术研究院度量衡办公室，“国际单位制——质量”：质量表示一个物体含有多少物质；质量的国际单位是千克（kg）；重量是重力作用在物体上的力。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (Mass versus weight).

text.en: TERC, The Inquiry Project, Grade 5, Investigation 13, Is air matter?, and Investigation 14, What are some properties of air?: two nested balloons are balanced, one pair is inflated with a pump and put back, and the pan with the inflated balloons moves down; a pump avoids adding moisture from your lungs; air can be squeezed into a smaller space; liquids and solids can be compressed too, but far less.
text.zh: TERC“探究项目”五年级，第 13 课“空气是物质吗？”与第 14 课“空气有哪些性质？”：两套套在一起的双层气球先在天平上平衡，用打气筒把其中一套打大再放回去，放打大气球的那一边沉下去；用打气筒是为了不带进肺里的水汽；空气能被压进更小的空间；液体和固体也能被压缩，只是少得多。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (Investigation 13, step 3; Investigation 14, step 2, at https://inquiryproject.terc.edu/curriculum/curriculum5/4_air/inv_14/index.html). This topic gives no numbers for the balloon demonstration: a blown-up balloon changes size, so the push of the surrounding air on it changes too.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（第 13 课第 3 步；第 14 课第 2 步，https://inquiryproject.terc.edu/curriculum/curriculum5/4_air/inv_14/index.html）。本主题不给气球演示配数字：气球吹大了，周围空气托它的力也跟着变。

text.en: Australian Academy of Science, Primary Connections, Communicating matters, Lesson 4, What a gas: push a cup with a dry tissue in it slowly straight down into water and the tissue stays dry, because air takes up space; tilt the cup and air bubbles escape and water comes in.
text.zh: 澳大利亚科学院“小学联结”项目，《物质的交流》第 4 课“气体”：把杯底塞了干纸巾的杯子慢慢竖直压进水里，纸巾不湿，因为空气占据空间；把杯子倾斜，气泡冒出去，水就进来。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (Testing ideas, part 1; Discussing claims). The model lets the air out through a hole instead of tilting, so the cup stays upright.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（“检验想法”第 1 部分；“讨论说法”）。模型用开孔代替倾斜放出空气，这样杯子可以一直竖直。

text.en: Cambridge Primary Science 4 (Cambridge University Press, 2014), Worksheet 3.3a, Squashing gases, liquids and solids: draw air into a syringe to 10 ml and seal it; for water, draw up about 12 ml, push the air out with the tip upwards and set it to 10 ml; then press each plunger.
text.zh: 《剑桥小学科学 4》（剑桥大学出版社，2014），工作纸 3.3a“压一压气体、液体和固体”：针筒抽进 10 毫升空气后封口；装水时先抽约 12 毫升，针口朝上把空气推出去，再推到 10 毫升；然后压每支的柱塞。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 in an extract hosted by a school (printed pages 83–84). The worksheet gives no final readings; the model's readings are calculated (S1). Its parts on particles and freezing are not used. In a classroom, press gently by hand.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 在一所学校网站上的节选中读取（印刷页第 83–84 页）。工作纸没有给出压后的读数；模型的读数是算出来的（S1）。工作纸里关于微粒和冷冻的部分没有采用。课堂上用手轻轻压。

text.en: J. Eix, A different way to do gas laws — Part 1: Pressure-volume relationship, University of Waterloo Centre for Advanced Science Education / Chem 13 News (2015), Figure 3: students' readings of a 60 mL syringe of nitrogen at 60.0, 45.0 and 30.0 mL as the gauge reading rose; the gauge and fittings added 4.3 ± 0.3 mL; barrel readings ±0.5 mL.
text.zh: J. Eix，《换一种方式学气体定律（一）：压强与体积》，滑铁卢大学高等科学教育中心 /《Chem 13 News》（2015），图 3：学生读 60 毫升针筒里的氮气，随压力表读数升高依次为 60.0、45.0、30.0 毫升；压力表和接头另占 4.3 ± 0.3 毫升；针筒读数 ±0.5 毫升。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. Measured readings from one classroom set-up with nitrogen, not air, and not a primary-school activity. Counting the gauge, the gas went from 64.3 to 34.3 mL, a little more than half.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。这是一套课堂装置的实测读数，用的是氮气不是空气，也不是小学的活动。连压力表一起算，气体从 64.3 毫升变成 34.3 毫升，比一半多一点。

text.en: American Chemical Society, Middle School Chemistry, Lesson 5.8, Can gases dissolve in water?: carbon dioxide gas is added to cold water under high pressure to make carbonated water; before the bottle is opened you should not see bubbles; opening it lets the gas come out as bubbles.
text.zh: 美国化学会《初中化学》第 5.8 课“气体能溶在水里吗？”：在高压下把二氧化碳加进冷水，就做成了碳酸水；瓶子打开以前看不到气泡；打开以后，气体变成气泡冒出来。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (Engage, steps 1 and 2). So the unopened can in the model has no bubbles in the drink; the gas is in the space at the top and dissolved in the drink.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（“引入”第 1、2 步）。所以模型里没开的罐子，汽水里不画气泡；气体在罐顶的空间里，也溶在汽水里。

text.en: National Library Board Singapore, Singapore Infopedia, Kaya: a sweet, creamy spread or custard made with coconut cream, eggs, sugar and pandan leaves.
text.zh: 新加坡国家图书馆管理局《新加坡资料库》“咖椰”：用椰浆、鸡蛋、糖和班兰叶做的甜奶油状抹酱，也可说是一种蛋奶酱。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. Also read: NLB BiblioAsia, Kaya: More Than a Spread on Toast (2026), which names egg, coconut milk and a sweetener; Science Centre Singapore, Sweet Science: Uncovering the Magic of Kaya Jam, on its creamy, spreadable texture; and M. K. Khong and others, International Journal of Engineering and Technology 4(1) (2007) 36–43, which measured that one kaya recipe flows more easily the faster it is stirred. None of them gives a rule for whether kaya is a solid or a liquid.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。另读：国家图书馆《BiblioAsia》“咖椰：不只是吐司上的抹酱”（2026），写的是鸡蛋、椰浆和甜味料；新加坡科学馆“甜蜜的科学：咖椰的奥秘”，讲它奶油般、可涂抹的质地；以及 M. K. Khong 等，《国际工程与技术杂志》4(1) (2007) 36–43，测得一种咖椰搅得越快越容易流动。它们都没有给出咖椰算固体还是液体的规则。

text.en: FIBA, Official Basketball Rules 2026 — Basketball Equipment, v1.0, §2.4 and Table 1: a size 7 ball is 750–770 mm in circumference and 580–620 g; the ball shall be marked with its recommended inflation pressure or pressure range.
text.zh: 国际篮联（FIBA）《2026 篮球规则——篮球器材》1.0 版，§2.4 与表 1：7 号球周长 750–770 毫米，质量 580–620 克；球上须标明建议充气压力或压力范围。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20 (page 12); valid from 1 October 2026. The 2024 edition gives the same size and mass. The model ball (75 cm, 600.0 g before pumping) is inside these ranges, but it is not a certified ball.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取（第 12 页）；2026 年 10 月 1 日起生效。2024 年版的大小和质量相同。模型里的球（75 厘米，打气前 600.0 克）在这些范围之内，但它不是经过认证的球。

text.en: Südzucker, White sugar: available grain sizes; mean aperture of the Standard grade 0.40–1.00 mm, Fine 0.40–0.65 mm, Extra Fine 0.20–0.40 mm.
text.zh: 南德糖业（Südzucker）“白砂糖”可选粒度：标准规格平均筛孔 0.40–1.00 毫米，细粒 0.40–0.65 毫米，特细 0.20–0.40 毫米。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. These are averages for each grade, not the size of every crystal. Sugar crystals vary in shape and some stick together; the crystals on the plinth are drawn to show the idea.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。这是各规格的平均值，不是每一颗晶体的大小。糖晶体形状各不相同，有的粘在一起；台座上的晶体是示意画法。

text.en: Adam Equipment, Dune compact balances, datasheet EN-6062 (2017): model DCT 2001, capacity 2000 g, readability 0.1 g; described for laboratories and schools.
text.zh: Adam Equipment，Dune 紧凑型电子秤规格表 EN-6062（2017）：DCT 2001 型，量程 2000 克，读数 0.1 克；说明适用于实验室和学校。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. One example of a school balance, used for the model's 0.1 g reading; the same table lists a 1 g version. Its linearity is 0.2 g, so the last digit of a reading is not its accuracy.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。这是学校电子秤的一个例子，模型照它读到 0.1 克；同一张表里也有读到 1 克的型号。它的线性误差是 0.2 克，所以读数的最后一位不等于准确度。

text.en: House of Marbles Australia, 16mm Meteor Marble: marbles measure 16 mm each.
text.zh: House of Marbles 澳大利亚，“16 毫米流星弹珠”：每颗弹珠直径 16 毫米。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. One common toy size; the model marble is not a particular product. A 16 mm ball has a volume of 2.14 cm³.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。这是一种常见的玩具尺寸；模型弹珠不代表任何产品。直径 16 毫米的球，体积 2.14 立方厘米。

text.en: Topeak, JoeBlow Sport Digital floor pump, specifications: volume per stroke 318 cc.
text.zh: Topeak，JoeBlow Sport Digital 落地打气筒规格：每下体积 318 毫升。

note.en: Read 2026-10-20. A maker's figure for one pump, showing that real strokes differ; the same maker lists 84 cc for a compact pump. The model's 0.2 litres a stroke, with no leaks, is a design choice, not this product's value.
note.zh: 2026-10-20 读取。这是一款打气筒的厂商数字，说明真实的每下体积各不相同；同一厂商的一款小打气筒标的是 84 毫升。模型每下 0.2 升、不漏气，是设计取值，不是这款产品的数字。
